subject.title: [Feature]: Mattermost — Parity improvements (formatting, reactions, rich interactions)

question: Should Mattermost read receipts and user presence remain in this umbrella, be split into a narrow canonical Mattermost issue, or be explicitly descoped from OpenClaw?
rationale: Source inspection shows no current Mattermost presence/read-receipt contract, and implementing one needs a privacy/product choice that automation should not make from an umbrella issue.

options.title: Split Remaining Presence Scope
options.body: Create or designate a narrow Mattermost read-receipts/presence issue and use this umbrella only as historical context.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the Mattermost parity tracker, accepting repeated review of already-completed subscopes.

options.title: Descoped For Now
options.body: Document that Mattermost read receipts and presence are out of scope for now, then close the umbrella after ack-reaction work is separately resolved.

recommendation.title: Split Remaining Presence Scope
recommendation.body: Create or designate a narrow Mattermost read-receipts/presence issue and use this umbrella only as historical context.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review already framed the remaining scope as a maintainer follow-up/product decision, and steipete is the clearest routing candidate from that history.
